abilities.name: Protective Disciples
abilities.trigger: ¿Hay una unidad aliada DESTROYER CULT a 3" o menos de este modelo?
abilities.originalText: While this model is within 3" of one or more other friendly **DESTROYER CULT** units, this model has the Lone Operative ability.

abilities.name: Infectious Murder-Madness
abilities.trigger: ¿Hay una unidad aliada NECRONS (sin MONSTER ni TITANIC) a 6" o menos de este modelo?
abilities.originalText: While a friendly **NECRONS** unit (excluding **MONSTER** and **TITANIC** units) is within 6” of this model, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, if that model has the **DESTROYER CULT** keyword or that enemy unit is the closest eligible target, that attack has the **[SUSTAINED HITS 1]** ability.

abilities.name: Prophet of Destruction
abilities.trigger: ¿Ha destruido este modelo una unidad enemiga en esta fase?
abilities.originalText: Each time this model destroys an enemy unit, select one other friendly **DESTROYER CULT** unit within 9” of this model. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

abilities.name: Deep Strike

abilities.originalText: Each time this unit makes an ingress move (20.04), if every model in this unit has this ability, it can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 8" horizontally from all enemy units, even if that is within your opponent’s deployment zone.

abilities.name: Deadly Demise D3
abilities.originalText: This ability always takes the form Deadly Demise X. On a 6, that model suffers a deadly demise; each unit within 6" of that model suffers a number of mortal wounds denoted by X (if this is a random number, roll separately for each unit within 6").
